name: @shepherdjerred/glitter-boys-launcher
description: Native Rust and egui Windows game installer and launcher

scripts.dev: mise exec rust -- cargo run --locked --package glitter-boys-app
scripts.test:local: mise exec rust -- cargo test --workspace --locked && bun test scripts
scripts.lint: mise exec rust -- cargo fmt --all -- --check && mise exec rust -- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.package: mise exec rust cargo:cargo-packager -- cargo packager --release --packages glitter-boys-app
scripts.release: mise exec rust cargo:cargo-packager bun -- bun scripts/with-publication-credentials.ts release.ts
scripts.release:prepare: mise exec rust cargo:cargo-packager bun -- bun scripts/with-publication-credentials.ts release.ts --prepare-only
scripts.release:preflight: mise exec rust cargo:cargo-packager bun -- bun scripts/release-preflight.ts
